## Entity

Marketing with Asmat is the performance marketing practice of Asmat. He works with United States DTC brands and lead gen businesses. The work is Meta Ads, Google Ads, creative, the store or landing page, tracking, and follow-up, owned by one person. The score is purchases, ROAS, and qualified calls.

## Questions and answers

### Who is Asmat?

Asmat is a performance marketer for United States DTC brands and lead gen businesses. He runs Meta Ads, Google Ads, creative, funnels, tracking, and CRM follow-up. 7+ years. $20M+ in ad spend managed. Top Rated Plus on Upwork.

### Do you work with businesses in the United States?

Yes. The work is remote for brands selling in the United States. Book a call, message WhatsApp at +1 667 788 2088, email asmat.llh@gmail.com, or hire on Upwork.

### What does a media buyer do for a DTC brand?

A media buyer owns the path from the ad to the sale. That means the offer, creative tests, Meta Ads, Google Ads, the product page or landing page, pixel and Conversions API, and follow-up. The score is purchases and ROAS, not cheap clicks.

### Should a Shopify brand use Meta Ads or Google Ads?

Most Shopify brands in the US need both. Meta Ads find new buyers with creative. Google Ads, including Shopping and Performance Max, catch people who are already searching. Both should be scored on purchases and ROAS.

### How much does it cost to hire a media buyer?

The fee is set on the first call. It depends on ad spend and whether the brand needs ads only, or ads plus creative, the store or landing page, tracking, and follow-up. There is no public rate card.

### How do I hire Asmat from the US?

Book a free 15-minute call at https://www.marketingwithasmat.pro/book, message WhatsApp at +1 667 788 2088, email asmat.llh@gmail.com, or hire on Upwork. Bring the ad account, the store or landing page, and the one problem to fix first.

### Which businesses does he work with?

United States DTC brands, mostly on Shopify, and B2B or B2C lead gen businesses that need qualified calls. Apparel, skincare, beauty, jewelry, and similar products are the core.

### Does he only run ads?

No. Ads without good creative, a page that converts, and follow-up still stall. He owns the path from first click to sale.

### Which ad platforms?

Meta Ads and Google Ads most of all. Search, Shopping, and Performance Max. TikTok when the product fits video. LinkedIn Ads for B2B lead gen.

### How fast can an account launch?

Most accounts go live in one to two weeks, once tracking, the offer, and the creatives are ready.

### Are the case studies real?

Yes. They are screenshots from real ad accounts. Client names stay private. Past results are not a promise of the same result.
